{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0",
  "catalogVersion": "1.0.0",
  "engine": "udi-deterministic",
  "context": {
    "type": "web-app",
    "goals": [],
    "constraints": {
      "preserveBrand": false,
      "brandColorTokens": []
    }
  },
  "profile": {
    "id": "PRO-GENERAL-WEB",
    "name": "General-purpose web product",
    "reason": "Selected because this profile applies to web-app; profile matching uses explicit type, audience-keyword, and style-keyword overlap."
  },
  "direction": {
    "visualPrinciple": "Favor clear hierarchy and content-led decisions over trend-driven decoration.",
    "typography": "Use a compact, readable scale with comfortable line lengths.",
    "color": "Use a restrained neutral base and accessible semantic colors; apply brand accents only after existing tokens are confirmed.",
    "layout": "Use consistent spacing and responsive content bounds.",
    "interaction": "Make controls, states, and next actions explicit and keyboard-operable."
  },
  "recommendations": [
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-VIS-001",
      "category": "visual-hierarchy",
      "title": "Give each screen one primary focal point",
      "guidance": [
        "Choose one primary heading, action, or data summary per viewport and give it the strongest combination of position, scale, and contrast.",
        "Reduce competing accents before adding another highlight; verify the focal point still reads at a glance."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-TYP-001",
      "category": "typography",
      "title": "Define a compact, semantic type scale",
      "guidance": [
        "Define named text roles for display, headings, body, labels, and supporting text rather than styling each element independently.",
        "Use fluid sizing only within intentional minimum and maximum bounds, and preserve readable body text on narrow screens."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-LAY-001",
      "category": "spacing-layout",
      "title": "Use a deliberate spacing scale",
      "guidance": [
        "Choose a compact set of spacing tokens and compose section, component, and inline gaps from those roles.",
        "Allow exceptions only when content or interaction needs justify them; avoid spacing values that drift screen by screen."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-RSP-001",
      "category": "responsive-design",
      "title": "Reflow content without losing information",
      "guidance": [
        "At narrow viewports, reflow columns, wrap content, or provide a scoped overflow region for genuinely tabular data.",
        "Check that headings, navigation, forms, and primary actions remain available at 320 CSS pixels and with text zoom."
      ],
      "priority": "critical",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-NAV-001",
      "category": "navigation",
      "title": "Use labels that match the user’s vocabulary",
      "guidance": [
        "Name destinations by the task or content users expect there, and validate ambiguous labels with representative users when possible.",
        "Keep the same destination label consistent in navigation, page headings, and help text."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-ACC-001",
      "category": "accessibility",
      "title": "Use semantic structure and meaningful headings",
      "guidance": [
        "Use native elements for headings, navigation, buttons, lists, and main content instead of styling generic containers to imitate them.",
        "Keep heading levels ordered by document structure, not by the font size a visual design requires."
      ],
      "priority": "critical",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-ACC-002",
      "category": "accessibility",
      "title": "Make keyboard focus visible and predictable",
      "guidance": [
        "Provide a visible focus indicator with sufficient distinction from surrounding states and avoid removing browser focus without a replacement.",
        "Keep tab order aligned with reading order and ensure overlays manage entry, dismissal, and focus return."
      ],
      "priority": "critical",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-SYS-001",
      "category": "design-systems",
      "title": "Reuse the project’s established design tokens",
      "guidance": [
        "Inspect the project’s current color, typography, spacing, radius, and elevation tokens before adding styles.",
        "Extend the existing token model with the smallest justified addition instead of introducing a competing palette."
      ],
      "priority": "critical",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-SYS-002",
      "category": "design-systems",
      "title": "Build components around stable semantic roles",
      "guidance": [
        "Define component variants around meaningful roles such as primary action, warning, or compact density.",
        "Keep page-specific composition outside the shared component unless repeated use demonstrates a stable pattern."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-SYS-005",
      "category": "design-systems",
      "title": "Preserve brand decisions as an explicit constraint",
      "guidance": [
        "When brand preservation is requested, reuse approved assets and tokens and limit changes to layout, clarity, and accessible pairings.",
        "If a necessary improvement would change a brand decision, explain the trade-off and request approval before replacing it."
      ],
      "priority": "critical",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-NAV-003",
      "category": "navigation",
      "title": "Keep global navigation distinct from local actions",
      "guidance": [
        "Place route changes in a consistent navigation region and task actions near the content they affect.",
        "Avoid mixing destructive or one-time actions into the same visual group as persistent destinations."
      ],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-COL-004",
      "category": "color-contrast",
      "title": "Design dark themes as a separate contrast system",
      "guidance": [
        "Define and test foreground, surface, border, and status roles for each theme rather than mechanically inverting values.",
        "Preserve hierarchy through measured luminance differences and verify charts and focus indicators in both themes."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "conflicts": [],
  "sourceRuleIds": [
    "UDI-VIS-001",
    "UDI-TYP-001",
    "UDI-LAY-001",
    "UDI-RSP-001",
    "UDI-NAV-001",
    "UDI-ACC-001",
    "UDI-ACC-002",
    "UDI-SYS-001",
    "UDI-SYS-002",
    "UDI-SYS-005",
    "UDI-NAV-003",
    "UDI-COL-004"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Project type was not specified; the web-app default and general-purpose profile were used.",
    "Audience was not specified; profile matching used project type and any supplied style or goals.",
    "Framework was not specified; only framework-agnostic guidance was assumed.",
    "Style was not specified; the selected profile uses a balanced, product-appropriate direction.",
    "No brand tokens were supplied; the direction avoids assuming permission to replace an existing identity."
  ]
}

{

  "context": {

  },
  "direction": {
    "visualPrinciple": "Lead with the customer outcome and make trust evidence specific and verifiable.",
    "typography": "Present rates, balances, and qualifications with clear units and careful numeric alignment.",
    "color": "Use a restrained neutral base and accessible semantic colors; apply brand accents only after existing tokens are confirmed.",
    "layout": "Give material terms room to be read near the relevant decision, including on narrow screens.",
    "interaction": "Disclose consequences and recurring terms before commitment and give clear recovery paths."
  },
  "recommendations": [
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-MKT-001",
      "category": "marketing-landing-pages",
      "title": "State the audience, value, and outcome above the fold",
      "guidance": [
        "Write a specific headline around a user outcome and support it with concise proof or explanatory copy.",
        "Use a primary call to action that describes the next step and provide a secondary path only when it serves a distinct audience need."
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [
        "SRC-UDI-ORIGINAL"
      ]
    },
    {
      "ruleId": "UDI-MKT-002",
      "category": "marketing-landing-pages",
      "title": "Build proof next to the claim it supports",
      "guidance": [
        "Place customer evidence, product detail, or measurable results near the related value claim.",
        "Label the evidence and its scope; do not imply an endorsement, metric, or customer result without permission and substantiation."
      ],
